sources.recovery_note: The Wiley DOI and DOI-PDF routes for Ribes-Zalesskii still exposed only the abstract in this session, and the existing frontier-28 liveness artifact had no archive snapshot for that citation. I therefore re-backed the orphaned Hall/LERF result with a different live treatment that states both the Hall theorem and the stronger Ribes-Zalesskii product theorem explicitly, while preserving the dead Wiley URL as provenance.
sources.title: Rita Gitik and Eliyahu Rips, On Products of Closed Subsets in Free Groups
sources.locator: Section 1 `Introduction`, arXiv PDF p. 1 lines 26-34 and p. 2 lines 38-42.

contents.name: Introduction, Hall's theorem: any finitely generated subgroup of a free group F is closed in PT(F)
Introduction, the Ribes-Zalesskii theorem: for finitely generated subgroups H1, ..., Hn of a free group F the product H1...Hn is closed in PT(F)
contents.reason: This stronger product-closure theorem is real but it opens a separate sequel on profinite closures of subgroup products. The current page stops at subgroup separability itself and does not need the higher-product refinement for any in-scope proof.
